findings.message: 1 frame reaches back further for main data than the decoder buffer of ISO/IEC 11172-3 allows, which holds one frame at the highest bitrate: the first at 0x9D01 has a main_data_begin of 511 bytes where at most 208 are allowed. Encoders such as LAME exceed it, and decoders accept it.
The last frame at 0xC641 has 757 of its 836 bytes.
